LocaleString.description: Contains a locale ID that you can use to grab the description for the item in your selected language. The ID is provided in a [key].[value] format where there can be an arbitrary number of keys (though it'll usually be 1). Then you can use these keys and values to query the <./locale/[language code].json> files for the desired description. These descriptions are intended to be surfaced to users of apps using the data in this repository and provide crucial context to the values shown to them.

DynamicLocaleString.description: The difference between this and LocaleString is that this one supports dynamically replaceable substrings, such as {{FlinchResistance}} or {{OrbOfPowerHealthRestore}} which will be filled-in from a property of each Character Stat with the same name. For example, {{FlinchResistance}} will be replaced with the value of the <FlinchResistance> property of the Character Stat. A numeric property can use an explicit formatter, such as {{EnergyGainScalar|ScalarPercent}}, to multiply a scalar by 100 and append a percent sign. This does not change the value of the exported property or the behavior of the existing {{Field}}{{Percent}} form, where Percent is a literal percent sign. AbilityName, ChargeCount, ChargeBasedScaling, BaseDuration and SuperDuration are contextual tokens supplied by the consumer per ability, not stat properties. BaseDuration is the source ability duration; SuperDuration is the calculated duration after applying SuperDurationIncrease where BaseDuration is defined.

Overview.description: Contains a high-level overview of the Character Stat and essentially serves as a replacement of Bungie's native stat description.

BaseStatTooltip.description: Contains a dynamic tooltip for the base version of the stat (0-100 points). These properties can either be numbers or arrays of numbers, depending on the property. If it's an array, the index of the array will be used to determine which value to use based on the Character Stat value. For example, if the <FlinchResistance> property is an array, then {{FlinchResistance}} will be replaced with the value at the index corresponding to the stat value, clamped to the field domain (0-100 for FlinchResistance).

EnhancedStatTooltip.description: Contains a dynamic tooltip for the enhanced version of the stat (100-200 points). These properties can either be numbers or arrays of numbers, depending on the property. If it's an array, the index of the array will be used to determine which value to use based on the Character Stat value. For example, if the <FlinchResistance> property is an array, then {{FlinchResistance}} will be replaced with the value at the index corresponding to the stat value, clamped to the field domain (0-100 for FlinchResistance). Enhanced-only curves use 100-200 and store the base value at stat 100; their array index is the stat value minus 100.

ChargeBasedScalingTooltip.description: This is a description of the Charge-based Scaling behavior of certain abilities. It is used to explain how the passive recharge speed of an ability may be increased by the number of active charges stored up. AbilityName, ChargeCount and ChargeBasedScaling are contextual tokens supplied by the consumer per ability, not stat properties. This tooltip is intended to be displayed only if the <ChargeBasedScaling> property is present in the <Ability> object. You can see an example of how this should be formatted here: https://github.com/Database-Clarity/Character-Stats/blob/master/docs/CBSD_example.md

Name.description: For organization/debugging purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

BaseCooldown.description: Base cooldown in seconds at a stat value of 0. Applicable CooldownOverride values replace this base first (last matching replacement wins in collection order), then all matching Scalar entries multiply it, then CooldownScalars[min(stat value, 100)] multiplies the result.

ChunkEnergyScalar.description: Nonnegative scalar for chunk energy gains.

ChargeBasedScaling.description: Entry i is the charge-rate scalar while i charges are stored (starting at i = 0). Array length is the maximum number of charges. AbilityName, ChargeCount and ChargeBasedScaling tooltip tokens are supplied by the consumer per ability, not properties of the stat.

EnhancedDurationTooltip.description: Locale ID for the enhanced-duration tooltip. Set only for Supers with a measured duration benefit.

Name.description: For organization/debugging purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

BaseCooldown.description: Fixed Super cooldown in seconds, independent of the Super stat. Applicable CooldownOverride values replace this base first (last matching replacement wins in collection order), then all matching Scalar entries multiply it.

BaseDuration.description: Base active duration in seconds. Set only for Supers with a measured duration benefit from enhanced Super stat.

EnhancedDurationTooltip.description: Locale ID for the enhanced-duration tooltip. Set only for Supers with a measured duration benefit.

Name.description: For organization purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

Requirements.description: Any matching requirement selects this override for abilities in the same stat: 0 is a wildcard, positive values are ability manifest hashes, and negative values are negated subclass hashes requiring consumer-side resolution. Each matching index selects the corresponding parallel-array entry.

CooldownOverride.description: Replacement base cooldown in seconds for matching Requirements (at a stat value of 0 for non-Super abilities). Applied before all Scalar multipliers and, for non-Super abilities, CooldownScalars[min(stat value, 100)]. If multiple replacements match, the last in collection order wins.

Scalar.description: Multiplies the cooldown duration for matching Requirements. After BaseCooldown or CooldownOverride is selected, each active Scalar multiplies the result, then non-Super abilities also multiply it by CooldownScalars[min(stat value, 100)]. A Scalar of 0.8 makes the cooldown 20% shorter; 1.25 makes it 25% longer.

ChunkEnergyOverride.description: Chunk energy scalars for corresponding Requirements, applied in place of ChunkEnergyScalar.

Name.description: For organization/debugging purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

BaseMobilityTier.description: Base hidden Mobility tier in PvE, and in PvP when no PvP value is specified.

BaseMobilityTierPVP.description: Base hidden Mobility tier in PvP when it differs from PvE.

BaseSprintSpeed.description: Base sprint speed in m/s, independent of Mobility.

WalkSpeed.description: Forward walk speed in m/s by hidden Mobility tier. Stat values 0-13: index = stat value.

StrafeMultiplier.description: Multiplier for left, right, and backward walking.

ADSMultiplier.description: Default walking multiplier while aiming down sights; active source effects can replace it.

ForwardSpeedCap.description: Maximum forward movement speed, including sprint, in m/s.

StrafeSpeedCap.description: Maximum strafe speed in m/s, including while aiming down sights.

CrouchSpeedCap.description: Maximum crouched movement speed in m/s.

MaxMobilityTier.description: Highest effective hidden Mobility tier; capped at the WalkSpeed curve domain.

Multiply all grounded movement, including sprint; does not affect jump height.
Multiply grounded movement except sprint; does not affect jump height.
Multiply grounded movement except sprint; does not affect jump height.
Replace the default ADS multiplier only for the selected held weapon; conflicting selected overrides require an explicit value.

Values.description: Entry i is the effect value with i + 1 stacks; length 1 for nonstacking effects. Unknown tiers use 0; unknown multipliers use 1.

BoostedValues.description: Replacement values when every BoostRequiresAll hash is equipped; length must match Values.

Hash.description: Manifest inventory item, plug, mod or perk hash, or item-category hash according to RefType; 0 warns that verification is needed.

FlinchResistance.description: Percentage ADS-only flinch resistance at each Health stat value. Stat values above 100 use the value at 100. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

OrbOfPowerHealthRestore.description: How much HP picking up an Orb of Power restores at each Health stat value. Stat values above 100 use the value at 100. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

PVPHealthHP.description: This number represents how much HP your Health has in most PVP activities.

PVEHealthHP.description: This number represents how much HP your Health has in PVE activities.

HealthRegenDelay.description: This number represents how many seconds after taking damage Health Regeneration starts.

HealthRegenSpeed.description: This number represents how fast your Health regens is % of total Health per second. Total Health can be found in the <PVPHealthHP> and <PVEHealthHP> properties.

BaseShieldHP.description: How much HP your Shields have in all activities (PVE and PVP), independent of the Health stat value.

PVEBonusShieldHP.description: Extra Shield HP in PVE activities at each enhanced Health stat value, added on top of <BaseShieldHP>. Below 101 there is no bonus. Does not apply in PVP. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

BaseShieldRechargeDelay.description: How many seconds after taking damage your Shields start recharging while the Health stat is not enhanced (100 or below).

ShieldRechargeDelay.description: How many seconds after taking damage your Shields start recharging at each enhanced Health stat value. Below 101, use <BaseShieldRechargeDelay>. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

BaseShieldRechargeSpeed.description: How fast your Shields recharge, in % of total Shield HP per second, while the Health stat is not enhanced (100 or below).

ShieldRechargeSpeed.description: How fast your Shields recharge, in % of total Shield HP per second, at each enhanced Health stat value. Below 101, use <BaseShieldRechargeSpeed>. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVEDamageResistance.description: This number represents the percentage damage resistance applied to Health, not Shields, in PVE activities, independent of the Health stat value. The current value is 34.5.

CooldownScalars.description: Dimensionless cooldown multiplier at each stat value. Start with BaseCooldown in seconds, replace it with applicable CooldownOverride (last matching replacement in collection order), multiply all matching Scalar entries, then multiply by CooldownScalars[min(stat value, 100)]. EnergyGainScalar.description: Values represent how effective external sources of Melee Energy are. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

PVEMeleeDamageIncrease.description: Percentage increase to Melee Ability damage in PvE at each enhanced Melee stat value. No ability-specific exceptions are currently known. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVPMeleeDamageIncrease.description: Percentage increase to Melee Ability damage in PvP at each enhanced Melee stat value. No ability-specific exceptions are currently known. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

ActiveRegenScalars.description: Values multiply the Super Ability's <ActiveRegenScalar> to determine active Super regeneration. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

SuperDamageIncrease.description: Values represent how much increased damage your Super Ability deals when the Super stat is enhanced. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

SuperDurationIncrease.description: Percentage duration increase for SuperAbilities that define BaseDuration. Supers without BaseDuration do not receive a duration change through this field. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVEOvershieldHP.description: Values represent how much Overshield HP casting your Class Ability grants in PvE when the Class stat is enhanced. This is raw HP, not effective HP after damage resistance. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVPOvershieldHP.description: Values represent how much raw Overshield HP casting your Class Ability grants in PvP when the Class stat is enhanced. PvP Overshields have 50% damage resistance; this value is not effective HP. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVPOvershieldDamageResistance.description: PvP Overshield damage resistance as a percentage. Do not apply this value to PvE; PvE Overshield damage resistance is unknown.

PVEClassAbilityDamageIncrease.description: Percentage increase to Class Ability damage in PvE at each enhanced Class stat value. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVPClassAbilityDamageIncrease.description: Percentage increase to Class Ability damage in PvP at each enhanced Class stat value. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

ReloadSpeed.description: Values are the percentage decrease in weapon Reload animation duration at each stat point. Convert a duration multiplier to a decrease with (1 - multiplier) × 100. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

Handling.description: Values are the percentage decrease in weapon Handling animation duration at each stat point. Convert a duration multiplier to a decrease with (1 - multiplier) × 100. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

NonBossDamageIncrease.description: Values represent how much increased damage your weapons deal against Minor, Elite, and Miniboss combatants. Stat values 0-100: index = stat value.

SpecialDamageIncrease.description: Values represent how much increased damage Special weapons deal against Bosses when the Weapons stat is enhanced. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PowerDamageIncrease.description: Values represent how much increased damage Power weapons deal against Bosses when the Weapons stat is enhanced. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

PVPDamageIncrease.description: Values represent how much increased damage your weapons deal against Players when the Weapons stat is enhanced. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.

LargeAmmoBrickChance.description: Values represent the chance of spawning Large Ammo Bricks through the Ammo Meter system when the Weapons stat is enhanced. Stat values 100-200: index = stat value - 100.
